column3: Plugin-metadata locale only ({"meta":{"title":"ui-trajectory"}}); the UI strings live in src/client/locales.ts, so two i18n systems coexist.
Chinese plugin-metadata locale; adds meta.description naming the four things the tab shows (messages, tool calls, duration, tokens).
Manifest: v0.2.1-rc.2, five client injections, exports ./client and ./src/*, ships only lib/ + locale/*.json, no runtime dependencies at all.
Per-heading-section en/zh hashes recording bilingual-pair consistency for README.md, regenerated by verify-translation-pairing --write.

Package reference: turn-aware ledger + timing overview; states the visible-window vs complete-resident-snapshot split, that a settled response does not mean the tools/turn finished, and that in-flight records show a start marker not a fabricated duration.
Chinese twin of README.md, structurally identical section-for-section so the per-section pairing hash detects drift.

Resolves a recorded run_code program; the language comes only from the recorded parameter description and only when unambiguous (TypeScript-and-Python => undefined), never guessed from source or runtime.
Four-line module holding COMPACTION_INTERRUPTED_ERROR = 'trajectory.compaction-interrupted', a stable non-display marker localized only at the render site.
Creates the browser-wide persisted duration preference (dsh.trajectory.duration), instantiated once per plugin lifecycle and shared by every session view.

Plugin body: registers five Definition families plus the view, provides the trajectory session hook, and injects the conversation.view tab whose inject() returns loadOlder/loadImage/duration; loadOlder reports whether the trajectory snapshot changed, not merely whether a page loaded.

The pure fold from snapshot to turn/group/cell rows: encloses a user message in the next assistant turn, advances the duration cursor past a landed compaction, builds wall-span + tool-histogram group descriptions, and appends a streaming partial without rebuilding the finalized turns.
193-key dictionary where zh is the key-set source of truth and en is typed Record<TrajectoryKey,string>, so a missing English string is a compile error; also the LocaleNamespaceMap augmentation.
Creates the browser-wide default for expanded JSON strings (dsh.trajectory.jsonStringWrapping), sampled only when a string is expanded rather than bound live.

Four projection modes (sequence/duration/time/actual) over the same layout, three semantic lanes, idle-gap compression, and focus selection by inclusive overlap; a cell with no startedAt yields no span at all.

Assistant step lifecycle: a retry resets the blocks but keeps firstTokenTime and usage, publication is animation-frame for deltas / immediate for settlement / none for usage, and a step closed without a message becomes an interrupted node at boundary.seq-0.9.

Correlates compaction/start, /summary, /end by compactionId and folds the compact-checkpoint user message into the same record, exposing the compaction as a first-class request with provider, model, usage and replacementSeq.

Type contract: the 8-kind TrajectoryContribution union, the target envelope, the snapshot shape, and the module augmentations that add the trajectory view target and the conversation.trajectory.images slot.
28-line shared wrapper that turns a contribution into the Engine-owned target envelope, anchoring it at a separate anchorSeq and falling back to an unresolved location.

Event-to-view conversion kept deliberately independent of Chat (jscpd-ignored); displayFailure drops the message of an AUTH failure so a provider-echoed credential never reaches UI state, and an unknown message-source kind stays visible.
Cell data contract and formatting: the identity ladder recordId -> callId -> sourceSeq -> index that survives prepends, null-means-unknown durations, and an em dash for null or NaN.
Bounded Markdown-to-text preview: 2048 source chars sliced before parsing, 512 output chars, with an explicit ellipsis when either cap bit.

Inbox splice chain materialized only on claim, so only the current claim can classify a later user/message as steering; a developer or non-user-source message becomes a context node with producer and form.

System-prompt and request-header Definitions with the prompt interpreters injected (a client bundle cannot value-import them); an uncertain surface yields system:'' rather than a wrong prompt, and a change can exist without a new header.

Incremental full-text index that reuses an entry when the record's sources array is unchanged (Markdown re-parsed only on change) and indexes schemas, thinking, prompt snapshots and every source block.

View builder: apply() treats a changed anchorSeq or a new node as structural and otherwise writes in place, a prompt change is consumed exactly once, a header is inherited forward, running compactions are closed at session boundaries, and the tool schema captured is the one visible at call time.
Root tool lifecycle plus nested PTC dispatch: edges are refused for self/ancestor cycles and a 256 depth cap, and a call that never returned becomes an Interrupted tool-result at boundary.seq-0.8.

Pure projection to measurable virtual rows: zero-height request separators attach to the next content row, a terminal separator keeps its own 9px row, and keys are encodeURIComponent'd so they are DOM-safe.
Legacy cell styles; the trailing metric lane is a fixed 320px documented as matching the turn header's column geometry, and subtool rows add 8px of left padding to read as nested.
Legacy standalone cell retained for direct consumers and specs; it destructures and discards most props, showing only index, kind tag, text, message metrics and elapsed time.
27-line stylesheet: a 36px title row whose description is ellipsised so a long wall-span label cannot break the row.
Title plus optional description; the description element is omitted entirely when empty rather than rendered blank.

1989-line stylesheet using a container query (not a viewport query) to collapse the event column and swap labels for icons; transparent summary scrollbars; the table is visibility:hidden until the tail is positioned.

3538-line virtualized ledger plus local inspector: stable virtual-row structure so a content-only stream update cannot invalidate measurements, opt-out tail following, a real table with aria-rowcount/aria-rowindex surviving prepends, kind-dependent tabs, and a retry error labelled 'Last attempt error' until the request itself fails.

Overview styles: the assistant span is a two-stop gradient splitting TTFT from decoding, the selection dims everything outside via two 100vw shadows, and viewport animation is gated behind prefers-reduced-motion.

Overview timeline: a non-passive wheel handler zooms the time domain exponentially at the pointer, right-drag pans and right-click clears, and the assistant bar is split into TTFT and decoding only when all three timestamps are finite and ordered.

Toolbar styles; the height is a CSS variable declared by the parent so the table can reserve it exactly, and an explicit .control[hidden] rule is needed because display:inline-flex would defeat the hidden attribute.

Sticky toolbar: the 'actual time' switch is fully wired but permanently hidden, the duration toggle's title flips to the other action's label, and the fold buttons swap a glyph rather than an icon component.
Styles one turn block: the body is capped at 880px and centred, the same lane the sticky header uses.
One turn section (sticky header plus padded body) carrying data-turn; not used by the current ledger, retained for direct consumers and specs.
Sticky turn bar: full-bleed fill but content in the centred 880px lane, with a 320px column lane and 8px right margin so Time aligns with the cell's trailing lane.
Sticky per-turn bar with Input/Output/Think/Time labels; the label row is aria-hidden because it is decorative chrome for sighted users.

View host: a 50-node history window anchored at the tail while request numbers and cumulative usage are computed from the complete resident snapshot, a 3s-throttled search index, a separate text-stripped partial projection for the timeline, and a composer-overlay contract via a CSS custom property.
Host styles: declares --dsh-trajectory-toolbar-height: 32px and reserves --dsh-trajectory-bottom-clearance from the composer's live height (152px fallback) so the final rows stay reachable.
Six-line ambient declaration making every *.module.css class a string, so a renamed class is a compile error at its use site.
Host loader entry exporting a deliberate no-op apply(); the empty body is a pinned contract (views.client.spec.tsx asserts it does not throw).
Legacy cell presentation plus the duration formatters; asserts metric column order by reading span order out of the DOM and that NaN renders as an em dash.

Acceptance test of the real tsdown artifact: runs lib/client.js through window.__ModuleLoader__.load, resolves externals through a require that throws on an unexpected specifier, and asserts the manifest id, inject list, plugin-tagged CSS injection and ring registration.
PTC inspector tests pinning that the wrapping preference is sampled on open (two open inspectors do not fight) and that a malformed argument string degrades the Code tab to a generic Payload view.
Table-driven cases over malformed PTC arguments and ambiguous schema descriptions; the tool-name match is exact (run_code_extra is refused) and the recorded source is byte-exact.

Acceptance suite driving the real ConversationNodeAssembler; a packedInputs helper replays live chunks through a real AssistantStreamAccumulator so the live-chunk and packed-attempt paths must agree, and the prompt model is pinned in replay/live/partial modes.

Context-source classification, assistant-block projection, failure redaction and the token-delta predicate; pins that an AUTH failure keeps its code and drops its message, and that an unknown message-source kind stays visible.

Layout fold tests: a landed compaction renders no cell but still advances the duration cursor, appending a partial leaves finalized turns referentially identical, and missing times yield null rather than NaN.
Shared test fixture (not a spec) that layers the trajectory dictionary over the common one and interpolates {name} placeholders for the English and Chinese translators.
Builder tests pinning header inheritance, one-shot prompt-change consumption, exact step header vs base header schema capture, and that running compactions close at the nearest session boundary.
One persistence test proving the browser-wide wrapping preference survives the view being recreated, with localStorage saved and restored around the case.

Ledger tests: a real SlotRegistry fixture for the image slot, virtualization asserted through observable consequences (aria-rowcount 500, bottom spacer, no scrollTo on a content-only update), the older-page anchor preserved at scrollTop 60, and retry history distinguished from current status in two languages.

Full acceptance suite on the real framework stack (SlotTestRuntime, UiConversation, SlotRegistry, real plugin fiber): disposal removes the tab and registries, the tab label follows the locale without re-registration, the preference is browser-wide with no per-session key, and the gesture grammar of the timeline is pinned.
Seven tests pinning that a row key does not change when an older page is prepended or a boundary joins it, the two row heights, and the exact DOM-safe escaped key.
Project config with rootDir src / outDir lib/types and 15 project references that declare the package's dependency graph to the build system.
Three-line bundler config: clientBundle(dirname, ['lib/types/index.js']) producing lib/index.js and lib/client.js with declarations as a separate artifact.
